intent: vendor preset "Large Snow 3D" (Nature) — validate against its thumbnail

iterations.critique: The render clearly reads as dimensional falling snowflakes on black, with varied sprite orientations and sizes. However, the mature frame is far denser than the earlier frame: t4 becomes a busy field of many small, dark outline flakes rather than a clean 'Large Snow 3D' look dominated by spacious, prominent flakes. The visual density buildup is especially noticeable across time and weakens the large-flake preset silhouette.

The snowflake sprites, black background, varied 3D orientations, and prominent large flakes fit the intended Large Snow 3D character well. Frame t1 is especially close to a spacious large-flake composition. By t4, however, the particle population has accumulated into a substantially busier field, with many small/dark flakes and several oversized edge flakes competing with the intended clean, sparse large-snow silhouette.

The render convincingly has the intended Large Snow 3D character: black background, detailed snowflake sprites, bright and dark orientation variation, and several prominent large flakes. Frame t1 has a suitably spacious composition. By t4, however, the visible population is much denser, especially through the center and lower half, with many smaller/darker flakes and cropped edge flakes making the field feel busy rather than clean and large-flake-led. The temporal buildup remains the main mismatch.

The black field, detailed snowflake sprite texture, varied 3D-facing brightness, and several clearly prominent large flakes all read convincingly as the Large Snow 3D preset. The motion between t1 and t4, however, still increases the visible population too much: t4 has a busy spread of small dark flakes across the center/lower area and several competing cropped edge flakes, whereas the desired silhouette should remain more spacious and led by a smaller number of large flakes.

The render strongly matches the Large Snow 3D look in sprite detail, black background, 3D-facing brightness variation, and prominent individual flakes. Frame t1 has an appropriately open, large-flake-led composition. By t4, however, too many additional flakes remain visible, producing a noticeably busier central/lower field and several distracting cropped edge flakes. The temporal population increase still departs from the preset's cleaner, more spacious thumbnail silhouette.
